summary: Writes a float value into a physics grid and sets a per-entry flag. Computes the float-grid index as a3 + 3*(a2+617), stores parameter a4 there, sets the byte at this + a2 + 7400 to 1, and returns the computed index. Called by WheelDynamicsInit.

operations.description: Compute the float-grid index as a3 + 2*(a2+617) + (a2+617), i.e. a3 + 3*(a2+617).
Store parameter a4 into this[computed_index], writing the value into the float grid array.
Set the per-entry occupancy flag byte at this + a2 + 7400 to 1.

unresolved: The 617 constant's meaning and the grid dimensions are unknown; a2 appears to be a row/entry index.
The relation between the float array and the byte-flag region at +7400 is not constrained by evidence.
The overall object type is unknown; the ABI lead PhysicsGridValueSet and the single caller WheelDynamicsInit suggest a per-wheel physics value table.
